title: Lenis Smooth Scroll
desc: Buttery, inertia-based scrolling that decouples the scroll position from raw wheel input. The baseline of nearly every awwwards site.

title: Staggered Scroll Reveal
desc: Elements translate up and fade in as they enter the viewport, each one slightly delayed after the previous. The workhorse entrance of modern editorial sites.

title: Parallax Depth Layers
desc: Layers move at different speeds relative to scroll, faking depth. Background drifts slowly, foreground overtakes — a two-line transform with outsized effect.

title: Horizontal Scroll Section
desc: Vertical scrolling pins the section and drives a horizontal track — the signature gallery pattern of portfolio and case-study sites.

title: Sticky Stacking Cards
desc: Cards pin on top of each other while scrolling; each incoming card slightly scales down the one beneath it. Pure CSS sticky with a pinch of JS.

title: Scroll Progress Indicator
desc: A hairline bar that fills as you scroll, plus a live percentage readout. Small detail, strong "crafted" signal.

title: Scroll Velocity Skew
desc: Content skews proportionally to scroll speed and eases back when you stop — the page feels like it has physical drag. A Locomotive Scroll signature.

title: Scroll-Driven Zoom
desc: A pinned media block scales from an inset thumbnail to full-bleed as you scroll through the section — the cinematic "expand into the story" transition.

title: Scroll Reading Highlight
desc: A long-form passage measures its own native scroll range and continuously fills each word from dim ink to bright paper-white, turning reading position into an exact sequential typographic signal.

title: Scroll Image Sequence
desc: A product-style canvas scene advances through 48 discrete, procedurally rendered frames as the local scroll position changes. The result has the precise, authored cadence of an image sequence without downloading a video or sprite sheet.

title: Scroll SVG Draw
desc: An editorial route diagram draws itself segment by segment as the local page scrolls. Every dash length is measured from the real SVG geometry, so the reveal remains exact when the paths change.

title: Scroll Rotate Gallery
desc: Seven editorial cards travel around a circular fan as the local panel scrolls. The card nearest the focus axis is selected from angular distance, then raised, sharpened, and scaled without relying on hard-coded active ranges.

title: Scroll Split Screen
desc: Four narrative chapters scroll on the right while a pinned visual field on the left crossfades continuously between their paired scenes. The transition is derived from chapter progress, so copy, imagery, navigation, and accessibility remain in lockstep.

title: Scroll Marquee Direction
desc: Three continuous type bands reverse when scroll direction changes, accelerate from measured scroll velocity, and lean into the impulse before settling upright. Direction persists; velocity decays independently.

title: Scroll Counter Rotate
desc: Two overlapping circular text paths rotate in opposite directions at different scroll ratios. A fixed optical center and synchronized angular telemetry make the counter-motion legible instead of ornamental noise.

title: Scroll Depth Tunnel
desc: Nine nested portal frames travel from a distant vanishing point through the camera on an exponential scale curve. Frames recycle after crossing the near plane, creating continuous spatial travel from a finite DOM.

title: Scroll Letter Scatter
desc: A headline breaks into individually routed glyphs as its section scrolls away. Every letter follows a deterministic quadratic Bézier trajectory, keeping the composition art-directed and perfectly repeatable.

title: Scroll Color Theme
desc: A compact editorial page continuously interpolates its full color system between four section palettes. Background, surface, ink, muted text, borders, and accent all travel together instead of snapping at chapter boundaries.

title: Scroll Clip Morph
desc: A circular hero aperture continuously becomes a full-bleed rectangle as the local section scrolls. Sixteen compatible polygon vertices preserve a real shape morph from first frame to last.

title: Scroll Table Of Contents
desc: A sticky table of contents tracks the section whose measured center is nearest the viewport center. Its active marker stretches into a directional pill while the article moves, then settles back to a dot.

title: Scroll Inertia Grid
desc: Three editorial columns share one native scroll target but converge on it at different rates. Their target-minus-current offsets produce visible, reversible lag without replacing browser scrolling.

title: Scroll Video Scrubber
desc: A 24-second photographic camera study timeline is driven by an inner scroll, a keyboard-operable range scrubber, and four chapter markers. Every input resolves through one canonical current-time value.

title: Cursor Gooey Blob
desc: A soft fluorescent blob trails the pointer through an SVG goo filter. Hovering a navigation target pulls the blob into the target until both shapes fuse, then releases it with a springy stretch.

title: Cursor Particle Emitter
desc: Pointer distance and velocity become a stream of sparks: slow movement sheds soft dust, fast sweeps throw bright streaks against gravity, and a press produces a compact radial burst.

title: Cursor Elastic Line
desc: A taut SVG cable bends toward the pointer from two fixed anchors. Its quadratic control point carries velocity, overshoots the cursor, and rings back to center when released.

title: Cursor Inverted Lens
desc: A circular optical lens follows the pointer over a graphic poster. Inside it, a duplicated scene stays registered while magnifying and tonally inverting the dark grayscale composition.

title: Cursor Text Repel
desc: Each glyph is its own spring body. Characters inside the pointer radius accelerate away with a squared falloff, rotate from displacement, and settle precisely back into the word when the field leaves.

title: Cursor Grid Ripple
desc: Pointer movement drops expanding wavefronts into a precision dot grid. Each passing ring pushes dots radially, flashes them fluorescent, and leaves a soft displacement afterimage that decays behind the wave.

title: Cursor Hover Preview
desc: Hovering an editorial link summons its own procedural media card beside the pointer. The preview trails with inertia, flips sides near an edge, and banks in the direction of cursor velocity.

title: Cursor Drag Ghost
desc: A draggable artifact stamps translucent copies along its path. Faster movement stretches and brightens the ghosts, while release velocity carries the original forward and leaves a final fading wake.

title: Cursor Eyes Follow
desc: Two oversized editorial eyes track the pointer with independently eased pupils constrained to elliptical sockets. The pair leans subtly into the gaze, and clicks trigger a tactile synchronized blink.

title: Cursor Liquid Metaball
desc: Six fluorescent masses become one liquid silhouette through blur-and-contrast thresholding. A springy pointer mass pulls nearby orbiters out of formation until their soft edges bridge and fuse.

title: Cursor Rope Trail
desc: A 22-point chain hangs from the pointer and solves its own slack through Verlet integration. Repeated distance constraints keep every link taut while gravity, retained velocity, and throws produce believable sway.

title: Cursor Velocity Stretch
desc: A fluorescent cursor body preserves visual mass while stretching along its motion vector and squashing across it. Three delayed echoes expose the velocity curve as the blob accelerates and settles.

title: Cursor Snap Targets
desc: A compact circular cursor becomes a spring-loaded outline around the active control. Each target contributes its actual bounds and corner radius while a small inner point continues tracking the pointer.

title: Cursor Flashlight Noise
desc: A soft beam cuts through near-blackness to reveal an editorial scene. Procedural grain exists only inside the light, while tiny layered oscillations make its edge breathe like an imperfect physical lamp.

title: Cursor Glyph Rain
desc: Clicks launch a compact storm of symbols from the exact pointer position. Every glyph carries independent velocity, spin, gravity, wall collisions, floor bounces, motion streaks, and a finite settling life.

title: Cursor Magnetic Grid Lines
desc: A precise SVG grid behaves like flexible wire inside a magnetic field. Nearby samples move toward the pointer with a squared falloff, producing continuous bows that brighten according to field energy.

title: Cursor Heat Shimmer
desc: Pointer velocity deposits luminous heat that rises, spreads, and cools through an off-white, orange, and charcoal thermal ramp. Additive radial fields overlap before fading completely.

title: Cursor Crosshair HUD
desc: A full-stage targeting HUD separates the live pointer from two spring-lagged axes. Their delayed intersection is tethered to the lead point and reports coordinates, speed, bearing, and lock state in real time.

title: Cursor Pull Distort
desc: An eight-point poster skin bows toward the pointer as though made from flexible film. Corners pull harder than edge midpoints, while a live wireframe exposes the spring geometry and its return to shape.

title: Cursor Shadow Parallax
desc: A movable light source casts a measured shadow in the physically opposite direction. Distance controls offset, softness, opacity, contact compression, specular position, and a restrained object tilt.

title: Custom Trailing Cursor
desc: A dot that sticks to the pointer and a ring that lazily chases it with lerp. The ring grows over interactive elements. Blend-mode difference keeps it visible on any background.

title: Magnetic Button
desc: The button is pulled toward the cursor while hovered, and snaps back with an elastic overshoot on leave. The label moves at a higher ratio for a layered feel.

title: Cursor Image Trail
desc: Moving the cursor spawns images along its path once it travels a minimum distance; each pops in, drifts, and fades out. A hero-section staple for photography and fashion.

title: Spotlight Mask Hover
desc: A hidden layer is revealed only through a circular mask that follows the cursor — flashlight over a dark page. Works for text swaps, hidden imagery, easter eggs.

title: 3D Tilt Card + Glare
desc: The card rotates in 3D toward the cursor with a moving glare highlight, and inner content lifts on the Z axis. Perspective on the parent is what sells it.

title: Split-Text Character Reveal
desc: The headline is split into characters that rise out of an overflow-hidden mask with a per-character stagger. The canonical award-site headline entrance.

title: Text Scramble / Decode
desc: Characters cycle through random glyphs before locking into place left-to-right — the "decrypting" effect. Strong with monospace fonts and technical brands.

title: Kinetic Marquee
desc: An endlessly looping text band whose speed and direction respond to scroll velocity. Seamless because the content is duplicated and wrapped with modulo.

title: Line Mask Reveal
desc: Paragraph lines slide up from behind invisible masks, one line after another. Calmer than per-character animation — the standard for body copy and manifestos.

title: Hover Letter Roll
desc: On hover, each character rolls upward and an identical copy rolls in from below, staggered across the word. The signature nav-link hover of high-end studios.

title: Proximity Type
desc: Each letter reacts to cursor distance — near letters swell and lift, far ones stay put, creating a wave that follows the pointer through the headline.

title: Odometer Stat Counter
desc: Numbers count up with a hard ease-out when scrolled into view, odometer style. tabular-nums keeps digits from jittering the layout.

title: Text Wave Hover
desc: A damped sine ripple travels outward from the exact glyph where the pointer enters. Propagation delay comes from glyph distance, so entering at either edge or the center produces a genuinely different wave.

title: Text Clip Image
desc: A seeded canvas texture of chromatic bands and grain pans inside oversized type. The moving fill is generated locally, repeats exactly across loads, and sleeps whenever the demo leaves the viewport.

title: Text Typewriter Caret
desc: Three messages cycle through explicit typing, hold, deleting, and gap states beside a blinking block caret. Character timing and state timing are independent, so pause and resume never corrupt the sequence.

title: Text Falling Letters
desc: Thirteen glyph bodies fall under gravity, bounce against a measured floor, collide with side walls, and sleep at rest. Clicking or keyboard activation applies deterministic impulses away from the activation point.

title: Text Blur Focus
desc: Seven words rack from eight pixels of blur into crisp focus, each settling scale, opacity, and tracking from one shared optical timeline. The sequence pauses offscreen and fully sleeps after its final word.

title: Text Strike Reveal
desc: A red strike draws across an overworked phrase before it rolls away and a sharper replacement rises into place. Hover and focus preview the edit; click latches it for touch and keyboard users.

title: Text Anagram Shuffle
desc: STATE rearranges into TASTE by moving the same five glyph nodes through measured FLIP deltas. Repeated T characters keep occurrence-based identities, so neither one jumps to the wrong destination.

title: Text Outline Fill Scroll
desc: A solid copy of oversized outlined type is clipped from left to right on hover or focus. The reveal is reversible from its exact current position and can be latched by click for touch users.

title: Text Ransom Note
desc: Every glyph receives an independently generated font, weight, paper color, rotation, offset, scale, padding, and irregular cut edge. A seeded sequence makes each reshuffle new but Reset perfectly reproducible.

title: Text Glitch Layers
desc: Cyan and magenta duplicates of a headline break into independently clipped horizontal bands during short seeded jitter bursts. The effect returns to a clean signal and stops its animation loop after 520 milliseconds.

title: Text Circular Spin
desc: Type follows a real SVG circle while its angular velocity eases from a calm idle to a fast hover orbit. Focus offers the same acceleration, activation reverses direction, and the loop sleeps offscreen.

title: Text Accordion Squeeze
desc: A studio menu redistributes a fixed vertical space on hover, focus or selection. The active row opens naturally while the letterforms keep their proportions.

title: Text Underline Magic
desc: One measured underline draws beneath a navigation label, then hops between targets on a small arc. Mid-flight retargeting begins from its current geometry, so fast pointer movement remains continuous.

title: Text Numbers Slot
desc: Four digit columns roll independently toward each new value. Every reel takes its shortest forward distance plus extra full turns, lands on an exact digit, then normalizes invisibly for the next transition.

title: Text Highlighter Swipe
desc: Four semantic key phrases receive irregular marker swipes when they become substantially visible in a local reading flow. Each phrase triggers once, then leaves observation until the sequence is replayed.

title: Text Broken Grid
desc: Six non-overlapping clip cells cut one registered headline into a displaced broken grid. Hover or focus removes each fragment transform so the partition tiles back into a single exact phrase.

title: WebGL Hover Distortion
desc: The image lives on a WebGL quad; hovering ramps a uniform that displaces UVs with sine waves around the cursor, warping the image like liquid. Raw WebGL — no three.js required.

title: Fragment Disintegration
desc: The element is sampled into thousands of pixel particles that scatter with drift and turbulence, then reassemble on demand — the "magic dust" appear/disappear.

title: Clip-Path Image Reveal
desc: Images wipe in via animated clip-path insets while the image itself counter-scales from 1.3 to 1 — the parallax-unmask that opens most award-site case studies.

title: Hover Zoom Project Card
desc: The classic project-grid hover: image zooms inside its clipped frame, a gradient scrim fades in, the caption slides up, and an arrow chip appears — all pure CSS.

title: Pixelation Reveal
desc: A photographic resolution study with six inspectable steps, a keyboard-accessible slider, and a replay control. The canvas samples the supplied coastal image at each resolution.

title: Focus Grid (Dim Siblings)
desc: Hovering one item restores its color and dims + desaturates every sibling. Modern CSS does it without JS via :has(). Directs the eye instantly.

title: WebGL Ripple Click
desc: Up to five click origins travel into a fragment shader as uniform arrays. Expanding signed wavefronts displace a procedural mineral texture, overlap additively, fade by age, and release the render loop when finished.

title: WebGL Pixel River
desc: A finite-difference noise gradient turns UV space into a flowing current before the result is quantized into a crisp pixel field. Hover, focus, or a touch latch deepens the shader displacement without changing the flow topology.

title: WebGL Fisheye Hover
desc: An aspect-correct shader lens magnifies a procedural image beneath an eased pointer. Radius grows on hover or focus, collapses on exit, and can be latched at a touch point without keeping an idle render loop alive.

title: WebGL Static TV
desc: A fragment shader begins as an unstable analog broadcast: RF snow, sync tears, rolling bars, and separated chroma. Hover, focus, or touch tunes the signal until a procedural coastal transmission resolves beneath the noise.

title: WebGL Kaleidoscope
desc: A procedural botanical texture is folded through mirrored polar sectors in the fragment shader. Pointer direction steers the sampling rotation by the shortest angular path; touch can hold an angle and keyboard arrows provide precise control.

title: WebGL Vertex Wave
desc: A 40 by 28 indexed grid carries an image-like procedural surface. Its vertex shader combines two traveling waves and a pointer-centered impulse, while pointer tilt reveals the mesh depth and hover raises displacement amplitude.

title: Image Slice Hover
desc: A single graphic is reconstructed across eight vertical slats. Hover or focus fans them through alternating depth, tilt, and vertical offsets; pointer position shifts the shared perspective and touch can hold the composition open.

title: Image Infinite Zoom
desc: A continuous geometric scale ladder carries procedural portal frames past the camera. Integer level identities persist across cycle boundaries, so the apparent reset is exactly the next nested frame rather than a crossfaded jump.

title: Comparison Slider
desc: Two matched procedural city scenes occupy the same coordinates while a native range control clips the restored version over the archival one. The divider is equally draggable, touch-friendly, and keyboard accessible.

title: Kenburns Crossfade
desc: Three procedural editorial scenes follow distinct camera paths while adjacent slides overlap through a timed dissolve. Navigation preserves the same pan/zoom model, and autoplay pauses offscreen or when reduced motion is requested.

title: Image Duotone Swap
desc: Two coordinate-identical poster renders use different two-color mappings. The alternate palette expands as a circular clip from the pointer entry point, follows the cursor while open, and can be latched for touch.

title: Image Shatter Click
desc: A procedural image is tessellated into 96 jittered triangles. Activation launches every clipped image shard away from the impact point with its own velocity, angular momentum, gravity, and fade before the composition can be rebuilt.

title: Image Blinds Reveal
desc: Ten horizontal louvers form a closed monochrome facade. Hover, focus, or touch rotates each strip around its top edge with an explicit stagger, exposing a luminous architectural scene through the widening gaps.

title: Image Magnetic Tiles
desc: One image is reconstructed across a 5 by 4 grid. A shared radial influence field gives nearby tiles coordinated lift, translation, and tilt, while damped spring integration keeps the fragmented surface moving as a single elastic sheet.

title: WebGL Hologram Particles
desc: Thousands of additive particles hold a rasterized wordmark together, flicker through a scan band, and spring away from a nearby pointer.

title: Neural Network Signals
desc: A layered neural graph routes weighted signal traffic, flashes on arrival, and reveals its complete downstream tree on hover.

title: Painterly Smear
desc: A soft procedural painting becomes wet pigment under the pointer, carrying sampled color through bristled smears before slowly drying back.

title: SVG Path Draw Hover
desc: Four line icons calculate the true length of every SVG path at runtime. Hover or keyboard focus releases the corresponding dash offsets in a per-path sequence, while touch can hold individual drawings open.

title: SVG Blob Morph
desc: A closed SVG blob is regenerated from sixteen corresponding radial samples. Hover selects a second organic state, touch can hold a third, and pointer angle adds a localized bulge without ever changing path topology.

title: SVG Squiggle Underline
desc: Three editorial phrases reveal measured hand-drawn SVG strokes on hover or focus. Once visible, each underline keeps a restrained two-frequency wobble generated in JavaScript, sharing one visibility-aware animation loop.

title: SVG Line Graph Live
desc: An eight-point SVG series draws itself from its measured length, then interpolates through three distinct datasets on activation. The smoothed line, filled area, markers, headline value, and pulse all share the same finite replot clock.

title: SVG Marching Ants
desc: A measured rounded-card perimeter carries two counterphased dash lanes and a sampled runner point. Hover or focus accelerates the integrated trace smoothly without restarting its phase, while touch can pin the faster inspection speed.

title: SVG Signature Write
desc: Five measured handwriting strokes are scheduled at distinct pen speeds with short lifts between them. A live nib follows the active path by arc length, making the signature feel written rather than revealed by one uniform CSS duration.

title: SVG Gooey Menu
desc: A central action expands four child bubbles through a true SVG blur and alpha-threshold filter. A separate synchronized button layer keeps icons, labels, keyboard navigation, and focus rings crisp while the colored shapes visibly merge beneath them.

title: SVG Topographic Drift
desc: Fourteen SVG elevation contours are regenerated from a coherent four-octave value-noise field. Their shared time coordinate drifts slowly, accelerates on hover, sleeps offscreen, and can be frozen without changing the terrain topology.

title: SVG Circuit Pulse
desc: Seven measured circuit routes carry independent light packets from a central processor to peripheral nodes. Every dash window and sampled glow point uses its own route length, while hover accelerates the shared clock without resetting packet positions.

title: SVG Lissajous Loader
desc: A 240-sample parametric curve holds, then morphs among four frequency-ratio figures. A separate dash phase and tracer point circulate continuously on the current equation, producing a loader whose geometry and progress remain visibly connected.

title: CSS 3D Cube Nav
desc: A four-faced content cube rotates in true CSS perspective. Tabs, arrow keys, wheel steps, and horizontal dragging all share one wrapped index and settle onto an exact ninety-degree face.

title: CSS 3D Card Flip Grid
desc: Eight tactile cards flip front-to-back along a diagonal wavefront. Each card can turn independently, while the master control derives per-card delays from grid coordinates and reverses the wave cleanly.

title: CSS 3D Book Page
desc: A linen-bound editorial spread advances through four chapters with a hinged half-sheet. Separate front and back faces, a moving fold shadow, and locked transition state sell the page turn without canvas or images.

title: CSS 3D Carousel Cylinder
desc: Eight poster panels occupy equal angles around a CSS 3D cylinder. Drag velocity feeds a friction loop, then the orbit magnetically settles on the nearest panel while controls, depth styling, and accessibility state stay synchronized.

title: CSS 3D Parallax Room
desc: Six transformed planes form a navigable CSS room with a framed back wall, side posters, floor, and ceiling. Pointer position drives a damped camera look while depth layers counter-shift to create a convincing interior.

title: CSS 3D Isometric Hover
desc: A compact interface decomposes into five labeled functional layers in isometric space. Hover previews the exploded architecture, while click or keyboard pins the state and keeps the layer guide synchronized.

title: CSS 3D Folding Map
desc: A four-panel field map opens along alternating mountain and valley creases. The unfold begins when visible, can be reversed or replayed, and preserves one continuous illustrated route across independently hinged panels.

title: WebGL Point Globe
desc: A 1,800-point Fibonacci sphere rotates in a raw WebGL shader. Projected distance to the pointer ray enlarges and brightens nearby particles, while drag adjusts orbit velocity and the render loop pauses offscreen.

title: WebGL Wobbly Sphere
desc: An indexed 48×32 sphere mesh breathes through layered trigonometric displacement in a raw WebGL vertex shader. Pointer speed injects a decaying deformation impulse, turning quick gestures into elastic surface ripples.

title: CSS 3D Depth Hero
desc: A cinematic hero is split across five Z planes: atmospheric field, horizon, title, orbital instrument, and foreground telemetry. A damped tilt camera gives each plane physically proportional parallax and can be calibrated or flattened.

title: Voxel Assemble
desc: A 180-block isometric monument assembles in a precise wave, excavates around the pointer, and collapses under gravity before rebuilding.

title: CSS 3D Exploded Device
desc: A four-layer device separates into chassis, logic, panel, and glass while a delayed technical guide identifies every plane.

title: Spring Cursor Follower
desc: A target and follower expose a real second-order spring model. Stiffness and damping sliders update the semi-implicit Euler integrator live, while velocity, displacement, and regime labels make each response measurable.

title: Pendulum Tags
desc: Five labeled tags hang at different lengths from a shared rail. Each keeps current and previous angular state for Verlet integration; pointer swipes inject local angular momentum, then gravity and damping return the system to rest.

title: Chain Links
desc: An eighteen-point chain hangs between two fixed anchors under gravity. Verlet position history provides inertia, six constraint passes preserve link length, and any interior joint can be grabbed without breaking the sagging structure.

title: Gravity Drop Icons
desc: Ten interface glyphs drop under gravity, bounce against the container, and resolve pairwise circle collisions into a loose floor pile. Any body can be grabbed and thrown using sampled pointer velocity.

title: Collision Bubbles
desc: Twelve buoyant circles exchange momentum through equal-mass elastic collisions inside a bounded field. The pointer acts as a soft moving body, separating overlaps and injecting velocity without teleporting the bubbles.

title: Soft Body Blob
desc: A twenty-four-node radial mesh forms a jelly body whose boundary is rebuilt as a smooth SVG curve every frame. Local pointer pressure compresses nearby nodes, neighboring springs spread the force, and volume compensation creates a believable opposite-side bulge.

title: Cloth Flag
desc: A 14×9 point cloth is pinned along one edge and solved with structural Verlet constraints. Layered wind waves travel across its columns, while the nearest free point can be pulled directly and released back into the fabric.

title: Wrecking Ball Text
desc: A gravity-driven wrecking ball swings from a fixed pivot and transfers its horizontal momentum into individual letter bodies. Impact launches, rotates, and drops each glyph against a shared floor before the whole scene can be reset.

title: Inertia Window Drag
desc: A compact floating panel samples pointer velocity while dragged, then coasts with frame-rate-correct friction and rebounds from all four container boundaries. Rotation and shadow derive from live speed so momentum remains visible.

title: Magnet Snap Grid
desc: Six draggable modules share a responsive slot map. Dropping one near another swaps their occupied slots, then both settle with a numerically integrated critically damped spring instead of a canned easing.

title: Liquid Blob Buttons
desc: Three button membranes deform toward the pointer, wobble through asymmetric radii, and dissipate their surface energy after exit. Clicks invert each membrane into an independent selected state.

title: Ferrofluid Dots
desc: A low-resolution scalar field combines thirty-five magnetic droplets, thresholds their summed influence into glossy ferrofluid, and stretches nearby sources toward a pointer magnet. Polarity changes whether the field gathers or recoils.

title: Water Ripple 2D
desc: A classic two-buffer height field propagates pointer disturbances across a reflective surface. Each cell derives its next height from four neighbors and the previous buffer, producing interference, reflection, and naturally decaying rings.

title: Lava Lamp
desc: Seven independently buoyant bodies rise through a high-contrast blur field, visually fusing whenever their soft boundaries overlap. A heat control changes ascent speed while the palette drifts continuously through a constrained hue range.

title: Ink Bleed Reveal
desc: Pointer-seeded ink blooms spread through a paper cover to reveal an editorial composition beneath. The mask edge is displaced by animated fractal noise, so each expanding circle feathers into an irregular capillary stain.

title: Melt Drip Text
desc: The rendered glyph bitmap is divided into narrow vertical source strips. Pointer heat accelerates nearby strips downward, stretching the actual lower letter pixels into viscous trails while untouched columns remain crisp.

title: Smoke Wisps
desc: One hundred eighty translucent particles rise from a heat source through a divergence-free velocity field derived from finite differences of procedural value noise. Persistent trails curl into smoke ribbons while the pointer pushes and twists the flow.

title: Bubble Float Pop
desc: Eighteen iridescent bubbles rise with size-dependent buoyancy and sinusoidal drift. Geometric pointer hit-testing pops a touched body into an expanding interference ring and eight droplets before it respawns below the surface.

title: Liquid Image Ripple
desc: A procedural dusk landscape sits beneath a two-buffer water surface whose height gradients displace and relight the source image.

title: Liquid Mask Reveal
desc: A noisy liquid aperture steers across paired procedural scenes, gathering orbiting droplets before flooding the frame on activation.

title: Slider Elastic Edges
desc: A five-panel editorial slider tracks direct pointer displacement, compresses movement nonlinearly beyond either boundary, and uses release velocity to choose the next page. A damped spring then resolves overscroll and slide snapping.

title: Slider Progress Fraction
desc: Five graphic slides share one explicit index with a vertically rolling two-digit fraction, a drawing progress line, and selectable timeline nodes. Direction-aware enter and exit states keep every indicator synchronized through button and keyboard navigation.

title: Slider Clip Transition
desc: Each incoming composition is revealed by a circular clip that begins exactly where the user clicks the stage. Button and keyboard navigation provide deliberate edge or center origins while the outgoing panel remains fixed beneath the expanding mask.

title: Slider Stack Deck
desc: A five-card editorial deck follows direct pointer displacement, derives rotation from horizontal drag and commits a dismissal by distance or sampled velocity. Dismissed cards fly beyond the viewport, recycle beneath the stack, and preserve a continuous queue.

title: Slider Fullbleed Parallax
desc: Full-bleed panels cross the viewport while their oversized media layers counter-travel at thirty-five percent of the panel distance. The differential motion creates depth at every transition, with a smaller pointer look continuing on the resting frame.

title: Gallery Filmstrip Scrub
desc: Horizontal cursor position maps directly onto eight editorial frames without a click. The large preview, thumbnail emphasis, timecode, playhead, and visited-frame count update from the same normalized scrub value.

title: Gallery Expanding Columns
desc: Five equal vertical panels redistribute the available width when one is hovered or focused. The active column grows to 3.6 flex units while siblings compress to 0.7, revealing editorial copy without changing the gallery’s outer footprint.

title: Gallery Honeycomb
desc: Fourteen clipped hexagonal cells form a staggered image field. Hover or focus promotes one cell, detects its nearest geometric neighbors from rendered centers, and propagates a delayed scale ripple while distant cells recede.

title: Gallery Random Stack
desc: Seven editorial cards are dealt onto a central pile with seeded random offsets and rotations. Every throw receives a new pose and higher z-order; once the full set is visible, subsequent throws recycle the oldest card to the top.

title: Gallery Dual Row Drift
desc: Two duplicated image strips share one animation clock but translate in equal and opposite directions. Hover freezes the offsets and eases every casually tilted card upright, turning a drifting collage into a clean contact sheet until the pointer leaves.

title: Lightbox Flip Zoom
desc: Six thumbnails expand into an in-stage lightbox using measured First and Last rectangles. The large card begins at the selected thumbnail’s inverse translation and scale, animates to identity over the backdrop, then reverses the exact geometry when closed.

title: Slider Wheel 3D
desc: Nine titles occupy a cylindrical vertical wheel in CSS 3D. Wheel and pointer-drag input move a continuous fractional position, then a damped spring settles to the nearest integer while the centered item receives focus, depth, and metadata emphasis.

title: Scroll Snap Carousel
desc: Five editorial cards make native horizontal momentum and snap alignment visible through center-weighted scale, dimming, and a shared progress indicator.

title: Menu Fullscreen Overlay
desc: A compact navigation bar opens a full-stage menu over an editorial hero. Five links rise in sequence while the scene beneath zooms and darkens; keyboard focus is trapped inside until Escape, backdrop, or close returns it to the burger.

title: Menu Split Reveal
desc: The visible page is physically divided into top and bottom scene halves. Opening the menu drives those halves beyond opposite stage edges, uncovering a warm navigation layer between them while its links resolve from the central seam.

title: Menu Circular Expand
desc: A floating burger seeds a circular menu mask from its measured center inside the stage. The coral navigation surface expands to cover the full composition, reveals four links, then contracts back into the same icon when dismissed.

title: Nav Blur Elevate
desc: A transparent sticky navigation bar watches a real scroll container. Beyond seventy-two pixels it compresses, gains a translucent backdrop, blur, hairline, and layered shadow, visually lifting away from the article moving beneath it.

title: Nav Hide Reveal
desc: A sticky article navigation samples scroll direction rather than a single threshold. Downward movement hides it completely beyond the top edge; upward movement calls it back through a brief twelve-percent overshoot before settling into place.

title: Nav Active Pill
desc: A single active pill moves between five navigation targets using measured First and Last rectangles. After layout jumps to the destination, inverse translation and scale preserve continuity while a deliberate 1.24× mid-travel stretch conveys speed.

title: Menu Letter Cascade
desc: Four large menu labels are split into individual glyph tracks. Activating one link lifts every character to an identical duplicate in sequence while its siblings recede through opacity and blur, creating a legible directional cascade without changing the text.

title: Menu Image Peek
desc: Four oversized menu links control independent full-stage preview planes behind them. Hover and focus crossfade the corresponding visual from a subtle zoom while pointer position counter-shifts the active plane, preserving link legibility over changing imagery.

title: Breadcrumb Collapse
desc: A long breadcrumb compresses its middle route into one ellipsis control. Hover, focus, or the demo control restores every intermediate segment using measured widths and a short left-to-right stagger; leaving collapses it without disturbing the current-page label.

title: Tab Morph Content
desc: Three tabs share one content viewport whose height interpolates between genuinely different panel sizes. Incoming and outgoing panels slide in opposite directions based on tab index, while the indicator and keyboard focus move as one coordinated transition.

title: Sidebar Rail Expand
desc: A narrow icon rail grows into a labeled navigation panel on hover or focus. Its wordmark, labels, shortcut hints, and footer identity arrive in a deliberate sequence while the content canvas shifts and dims to preserve spatial hierarchy.

title: Burger Morph X
desc: A precisely spaced three-line menu glyph becomes an X by collapsing its center stroke and moving the outer strokes onto one axis before rotating them. The stagger is echoed by a compact navigation sheet whose links rise into view in sequence.

title: Mega Menu Preview
desc: A compact product nav opens into a split mega menu whose staggered links drive one persistent, direction-aware procedural preview pane.

title: Button Border Beam
desc: A narrow highlight travels around a dark call-to-action without filling its face. The effect is built from an oversized rotating conic layer clipped to a one-pixel perimeter, with deliberate pause, focus, activation-pulse, and reset states.

title: Button Shimmer Sweep
desc: A narrow diagonal specular band crosses a satin button exactly once for each new pointer or keyboard entry. Repeated movement while still inside cannot restart it, and the highlight cleans itself up after animation so the surface returns to a quiet resting state.

title: Button Text Slide Swap
desc: A button label occupies a clipped one-line window containing two identical rows. Intent moves the whole two-row track upward so the first copy exits as the second arrives from below, with per-word accents and an arrow response synchronized to the same easing.

title: Button Icon Hop
desc: An arrow leaves its socket in a short forward-up arc, lands ahead, returns to origin, and rests before repeating. The loop only runs while intent is present, with iteration telemetry that makes the deliberate pause distinguishable from a constant translation.

title: Button Success Morph
desc: A wide submit control contracts to a circular loader, then opens into a green confirmation state whose checkmark draws on. Every phase is a real state with cancellation-safe timers, synchronized ARIA busy/disabled semantics, and explicit width targets.

title: Button Confetti Burst
desc: A button launches a compact canvas burst from its own center rather than raining decoration from the viewport. Forty-two paper particles inherit seeded radial velocities, gravity, drag, rotation, and individual lifetimes before the renderer shuts itself down.

title: Button Material Ripple
desc: Each activation creates a circle at the true pointer position and sizes it from the farthest button corner, guaranteeing complete coverage from any origin. Keyboard and demo activations use the center while overlapping ripples clean themselves up independently.

title: Button Jelly Press
desc: A soft action button widens and compresses under impact, rebounds tall and narrow, then resolves through a smaller counter-overshoot. The transform sequence is triggered at pointer-down or keyboard-down so feedback begins at contact, not after click.

title: Like Heart Particles
desc: A semantic like toggle fills its heart with a springy overshoot while twelve colored particles launch around its perimeter. The burst occurs only on the transition into liked state; unliking returns quietly so repeated state changes remain legible.

title: Checkbox Draw Check
desc: A native checkbox drives a custom square whose SVG tick draws from dashoffset while the box compresses and rebounds. The actual input remains focusable and authoritative, so pointer, keyboard, programmatic demo, and reset all travel through the same checked state.

title: Toggle Day Night
desc: A wide theme switch moves its celestial thumb from a ray-ringed sun into a cutout crescent while clouds descend and five stars appear in sequence. The surrounding scene, labels, and accessible pressed state all follow one shared theme value.

title: Copy Inline Feedback
desc: A code-row copy action writes a real value through the Clipboard API with an execCommand fallback, morphs overlapping document outlines into a check, and lifts a compact Copied chip above the trigger before returning to idle.

title: Hover Tooltip Spring
desc: A compact tooltip springs from the edge facing its anchor, overshoots into place, and then follows pointer movement with a restrained requestAnimationFrame lag. Hover and focus share the same accessible description while leave and blur settle it closed.

title: Badge Notification Pop
desc: A notification badge increments through a clipped two-row digit track while the orange capsule compresses, overshoots, and settles. Each queued increment starts from the currently committed digit, preventing visual jumps during repeated updates.

title: Button Polish Stages
desc: One button progresses from a flat rectangle to a detailed production control, making each layer of polish visible on the same element.

title: Input Float Label
desc: A native email input begins with its label occupying the placeholder position. Focus or content lifts and scales the label into the border, changes its color, and reveals a concrete format hint; blur only returns it when the value is genuinely empty.

title: Input Underline Grow
desc: A minimal text field records where pointer intent enters and grows its focus line outward from that exact horizontal coordinate. Keyboard focus uses a centered origin, so the same native input produces a spatially meaningful response without pointer-only semantics.

title: Input Shake Error
desc: A required project-code field validates on submit and answers failure with a six-step damped horizontal shake, border flash, associated error message, and focused correction state. Valid submission clears the error without replaying the motion.

title: Input Character Counter Arc
desc: A native maxlength textarea maps its exact character ratio onto an SVG ring. The counter remains quiet through normal writing, warms at eighty percent, and turns urgent at the limit while the browser itself prevents overflow.

title: OTP Code Boxes
desc: Six real one-character inputs cooperate as one verification-code control. Numeric entry advances focus, Backspace crosses into the previous box, Arrow keys navigate, and a pasted code is filtered and distributed with a short filled-box pop.

title: Password Strength Bar
desc: A native password field evaluates four transparent rules on every edit. The number of satisfied rules controls the meter width, hue, descriptive level, and individual checklist ticks, while a visibility toggle preserves focus and value.

title: Select Morph Dropdown
desc: An accessible custom select grows its option panel directly from the trigger edge. Height, clip-path, arrow rotation, and staggered option offsets share one state while pointer, arrows, Home/End, Enter, Space, and Escape preserve proper focus and selection semantics.

title: Range Elastic Thumb
desc: A native range input drives a separate visual thumb whose horizontal scale follows pointer velocity. Fast movement stretches in its travel direction, the inner dot counter-shifts to preserve weight, and release springs the control back without sacrificing keyboard input.

title: Textarea Auto Grow
desc: A native textarea measures its own scrollHeight after every edit, smoothly grows or shrinks between two and six lines, and enables internal scrolling only after reaching the cap. A ruled shadow behind it makes each height change legible.

title: Form Multistep Progress
desc: A real three-step form slides one fieldset at a time while its connecting progress line and numbered dots fill only after valid forward transitions. Backward navigation preserves answers, invalid advancement explains the blocker, and completion turns the final dot into a check.

title: Preloader Percentage
desc: A full-stage preloader advances from 0 to 100 with deliberately uneven eased pacing, couples the numeral to a measured progress rule, and only lifts its two-part curtain after the terminal frame is committed. Replay cancels stale frames instead of stacking timelines.

title: Preloader Word Cycle
desc: Five greetings occupy one clipped baseline, each old word rolling upward as the next enters from below. A numbered rail advances with the language index; only after the final greeting settles does a warm horizontal panel wipe the loader away.

title: Loader Dots Wave
desc: Three dots share one animation clock and sample the same sine at 120-degree offsets, producing a mathematically even traveling wave. Pause preserves phase, speed changes preserve elapsed time, and a quarter-cycle inspection state exposes the exact offsets instead of relying on three unrelated CSS delays.

title: Loader Morph Shapes
desc: Square, triangle, and circle are normalized to twelve corresponding SVG points, then interpolated numerically from one geometry to the next on a single clock. A deterministic halfway state reveals the real point math; no border-radius or crossfade disguises the morph.

title: Loader Typing Code
desc: A terminal loader types two real-looking commands character by character, inserts output as separate events, lands on a green ready state, then clears its history in reverse. Every timeout is token-gated so replay, instant completion, and reset cannot leak stale characters.

title: Skeleton Shimmer
desc: A realistic article card begins as five differently sized skeleton regions. Their shimmer gradients share one duration but carry measured 70ms delays, then data arrival crossfades the whole placeholder layer against semantic content instead of replacing nodes abruptly.

title: Progress Blob Fill
desc: Progress rises inside a clipped glass vessel while an SVG path samples a moving sine surface across nine points. The liquid level pursues a numeric target independently from wave phase, so completion, pause, inspection, and reset all preserve truthful percentage geometry.

title: Loader Orbit Dots
desc: Three particles orbit at different radii and signed angular velocities from one clock. Four lagged samples behind each head form geometric trails, making speed and direction legible without canvas blur or duplicated animation timelines.

title: Upload Progress Morph
desc: A wide upload button contracts into a circular control, drives an SVG progress ring from the actual percentage, then replaces the arrow with a drawn check and expanding completion ring. Replay and reset cancel the active upload frame before restoring geometry.

title: Page Load Counter Slide
desc: A three-column numeral counter rolls only the digits that change while an eased load value advances to 100. The terminal value is held and committed before the full panel lifts, so the reveal cannot race ahead of its own progress display.

title: Chart Bars Race
desc: Four ranked bars transition between two datasets. Before changing rank, each row records its viewport position; after new top positions are assigned, the measured delta is animated back to zero while width and numeric value update independently.

title: Chart Donut Sweep
desc: Four independent SVG arcs sweep in one after another. Each segment owns its real circumference length, angular start, local progress window, and numeric count, so the legend cannot arrive before its matching stroke.

title: Sparkline Hover Scrub
desc: A compact SVG sparkline converts pointer x into the nearest of twelve samples, then moves a crosshair, point marker, and value bubble to the same coordinate. Arrow, Home, and End keys use the identical selection function.

title: Heatmap Fade In
desc: A six-week calendar heatmap reveals along diagonals because each cell delay is derived from row plus column, not DOM order. Every cell is a focusable button whose pointer and focus states share one anchored contribution tooltip.

title: Ticker Tape Prices
desc: A duplicated market track scrolls seamlessly while deterministic ticks update five instruments in place. Positive and negative deltas produce separate color flashes that clear independently from the continuous tape motion.

title: Radar Sweep Blips
desc: Five fixed polar targets are revealed when a rotating sweep passes their angle, then fade exponentially until the next pass. Sweep, targets, and intensity all share one RAF clock; an exact 140-degree inspection proves the angular hit rule.

title: Map Topo Extrude
desc: A seeded heatmap reconstructs itself as a compact topographic model. Its 216 cells rise by elevation, reveal shaded bottom faces and a snow line, then flatten in the exact reverse order.

title: Map City Tiles
desc: A seeded street grid assembles from the center outward, reveals its labels, and draws a historic district around the river-split city.

title: Map Dot Globe Arcs
desc: A dense procedural dot globe carries deterministic city-to-city routes. Violet arc heads cross the near hemisphere, arrivals pulse, and hovering or focusing slows the orbit for inspection.

title: Map Route Draw
desc: A courier marker draws a deterministic route across a seeded Manhattan street graph, easing through every turn, leaving fading passes, and accepting accessible click or keyboard reroutes.

title: Map Radar Pings
desc: Six deterministic map sites land, pulse on independent radar schedules, and separate into two restrained parallax depths, with one faster anomaly kept deliberately visible.

title: Map Isoline Field
desc: A deterministic two-octave elevation field becomes seven live contour bands. A softly eased heat source bends the topology while cached index labels remain steady inside real line gaps.

title: FUI Status Dashboard
desc: A compact four-module system monitor with animated power, thermal, shield, and diagnostic telemetry. The hard-edged framing and restrained activity make dense fictional interfaces feel operational instead of decorative.

title: FUI Target Lock
desc: A cursor-tracking HUD reticle that acquires drifting telemetry chips with staggered corner brackets and a typed geometry readout. Keyboard focus triggers the same lock sequence for an equally precise non-pointer path.

title: FUI Terminal Boot
desc: A compact fictional boot console emits, resolves, and clears fourteen device mounts through a cancellation-safe loop. Seeded timing keeps the terminal organic while preserving a reproducible inspection state.

title: FUI Waveform Scope
desc: A pointer-tunable oscilloscope layers harmonics into a persistent phosphor trace with an exact frame-decay model. Pointer and keyboard activation can freeze the live signal for a measured hold.

title: FUI Signal Scanner
desc: A narrowband spectrum scanner sweeps sixty-four exact signal columns, pauses over a pointer-selected band, and surfaces deterministic contact spikes. Its discrete geometry gives the fictional radio interface the cadence of real instrumentation.

title: FUI Data Stream
desc: Four independently clocked telemetry lanes recycle seeded packets at distinct rates. Hover or focus isolates one stream for inspection without perturbing the other generators, while a separate active-time channel surfaces transient packet flashes.

title: FUI Access Granted
desc: A deterministic authorization target choreographs broken fingerprint arcs, twin scans, a machine-speed hash, and a restrained grant or denial stamp. Every fourth run rejects, making both semantic outcomes available without sacrificing the cinematic FUI cadence.

title: FUI Hex Dump
desc: A virtualized memory window derives every byte from its absolute address, so recycling never changes the dump. Pointer and keyboard inspection bind hexadecimal and ASCII twins while a separate active-time channel marks transient four-byte signatures.

title: FUI Trading Terminal
desc: A deterministic three-widget market terminal shares one active-time clock across a shifting price trace, mirrored order book, and rising trade tape. Every panel remains live while its measured slot can be swapped or collapsed.

title: FUI Orbital Tracker
desc: A deterministic three-satellite mission display layers front and occluded orbit halves, fading trails, an active-time telemetry typer, and a ground-station pass over a compact wireframe planet.

title: Agent Token Meter
desc: A deterministic context-window gauge turns live token bursts into throughput, cumulative session cost, warning states and an inspectable compaction cycle.

title: Agent Deploy Pipeline
desc: A deterministic four-stage deployment rail streams bounded logs, exercises an exact one-in-three TEST failure and automatically retries before production.

title: Agent Context Compaction
desc: A deterministic chat history folds its oldest message groups into inspectable context chips whenever the token rail crosses its compaction marker.

title: Agent Node Graph
desc: A draggable executable DAG sends deterministic agent activity through live cubic connectors and supports cycle-safe port-to-port composition.

title: Agent Streaming Text
desc: A realistic burst-cadence assistant response resolves rich text and a code sample while token and latency counters advance in sync.

title: Agent Thinking Drawer
desc: A compact live-reasoning chip expands into an accessible streaming trace, then settles into a concise completed disclosure.

title: Agent Diff Review
desc: A compact AI edit proposal streams a readable diff, then resolves into clean accepted or reverted code before replaying.

title: Knowledge Orbit
desc: A query concept anchors three semantic-distance rings while related ideas orbit, cluster on inspection, and swap into the center for an endless drill-down.

title: Particles Constellation
desc: A deterministic particle field drifts across a DPR-aware canvas and draws links only below an 86px threshold. Pointer force falls off with distance and can switch between attraction and repulsion without changing the shared simulation clock.

title: Gradient Mesh Drift
desc: Five oversized color fields drift on independent sine pairs beneath a soft blend layer. Pointer movement finds the nearest field center and nudges only that blob, preserving the ambient motion rather than dragging the whole background.

title: Flow Field
desc: A seeded particle stream follows a curl-like trigonometric field. Moving across the canvas installs a localized vortex that bends nearby trails without replacing the underlying flow.

title: Starfield Warp
desc: Seeded stars advance through a perspective camera and recycle at the near plane. Hovering eases flight speed upward and lengthens each star into a depth-correct streak.

title: Conway Life Fade
desc: Conway’s rules run on a 32×20 grid while dead cells retain a short phosphor afterglow. Pointer drawing writes live cells directly into the simulation instead of applying a decorative overlay.

title: Audio Reactive Bars
desc: Twenty-four frequency bars combine three phase-offset sine bands. Pointer position selects a frequency neighborhood and injects energy that spreads to adjacent bars before decaying.

title: Matrix Rain
desc: Seeded glyph columns fall at independent rates with bright heads and fading tails. The cursor opens a soft circular aperture by suppressing glyph opacity inside its radius.

title: Fireflies Night
desc: Seeded fireflies wander with individual phase noise and pulsing light. A stationary pointer becomes an attractor only after an idle delay, so exploration stays loose before the swarm gathers.

title: Aurora Curtains
desc: Four feathered atmospheric curtains follow phase-shifted sine envelopes and blend through diffuse vertical light. Pointer movement pushes a temporary horizontal gust through the nearest curtain segment.

title: Rain Window
desc: Seeded droplets creep down glass with lateral random walk, refractive highlights, and size-dependent speed. Nearby drops coalesce into a heavier drop that accelerates down the pane.

title: UI Sound Kit
desc: Four interface controls synthesize their own short envelopes: hover ticks, confirm bells, warning drops, and a two-note toggle. AudioContext creation happens only inside a user gesture.

title: Typing Mechanical
desc: Each printable keystroke synthesizes a short filtered-noise thock plus a pitched body tone. Roboto Mono-key timing controls velocity, brightness, and key travel so fast typing feels sharper than deliberate typing.

title: Theremin Pad
desc: A press-and-drag surface maps horizontal position logarithmically across two octaves and vertical position to amplitude. A live trace records the performed gesture while audio exists only during contact.

title: Notification Chime Stack
desc: Each new toast enters a springy stack and receives the next scale degree. A gesture-gated three-note chime climbs with stack depth, while dismissing a toast compacts the remaining cards.

title: Drum Grid Sequencer
desc: A mutable 4×8 step grid drives four synthesized percussion voices. The playhead advances at the selected tempo, highlights each column, and reads active cells at playback time.

title: Scroll Pitch Drone
desc: An opt-in headphone drone combines two quiet oscillators. Measured scroll velocity opens its low-pass filter, raises pitch slightly, and tilts a spectral horizon before easing back to rest.

title: DVD Screensaver
desc: A logo moves with fixed-step rectangle physics, preserving overshoot when it reflects off each edge. Simultaneous axis collisions count as corner hits and rotate the palette.

title: Konami Unlock
desc: A focused card matches the classic ten-key sequence incrementally, recovers overlapping starts after mistakes, and unlocks a rainbow party with generated confetti only after the exact code.

title: Click Fireworks
desc: Clicking launches a rocket from the ground toward the target. On arrival it becomes a radial spark burst with persistent trails, drag, gravity, hue variation, and alpha decay.

title: Drag To Break
desc: A draggable specimen samples pointer velocity and accumulates only directional shake energy. Crossing the first threshold draws cracks; continued shaking releases twelve independently moving fragments.

title: Pet The Blob
desc: A springy blob watches and leans toward the cursor. Slow strokes across its body accumulate affection, trigger a squash, and move it through curious, petted, and happy states.

title: Gravity Flip Page
desc: Eight interface fragments are simulated as independent bodies. Flipping gravity sends every body to the opposite boundary with per-body restitution, rotation, and collision damping.

title: Wobbly Window Drag
desc: A draggable desktop window follows its pointer target through a damped spring. The lag velocity stretches, skews, and counter-rotates the panel before it settles back into a rigid rectangle.

title: Snake In Grid
desc: A complete snake game runs on a 20×14 dot matrix with buffered non-reversing input, deterministic food positions, self and wall collision, score, pause, and exact restart.

title: Bottom Sheet
desc: A mobile bottom sheet follows pointer drag with resistance beyond its bounds. Release velocity projects the landing position before selecting peek, half, or full snap.

title: Radial Menu
desc: Holding the central trigger fans six commands around a circle. Pointer angle selects a sector while distance gates activation; release commits the highlighted command.

title: Elastic Tabs
desc: A measured tab indicator travels through a damped spring rather than a CSS slide. Its instantaneous velocity stretches the pill horizontally, squashes it vertically, and overshoots the target.

title: Masonry Filter
desc: A variable-height project grid filters by category. Surviving cards capture first and last rectangles and animate the inverse delta, while removed and returning cards get distinct exit and entrance treatments.

title: Command Palette
desc: A keyboard-first command palette opens with Ctrl/⌘K, ranks commands by ordered-character fuzzy match, highlights matched letters, and supports wrapping arrow navigation and execution.

title: Toast Stack
desc: Notifications enter at the top of a compact stack and push older cards backward with spring easing. Hovering fans the stack into readable rows; dismissing any card compacts the survivors.

title: Number Input Drag
desc: Dragging the numeric label scrubs its value horizontally. Travel distance adds acceleration, Shift enables tenth-step precision, Alt slows movement, and direct keyboard editing stays available.

title: Context Menu Custom
desc: Right-clicking the mock workspace opens a custom menu clamped to the card bounds. Its scale origin follows the click quadrant, and the Share item slides a keyboard-accessible submenu inward.

title: Resizable Split Pane
desc: A measured divider resizes two working panes between 20% and 80%. Ratios within four points of 25, 50, or 75 magnetize to that snap, while keyboard and double-click controls remain available.

title: Card Hover Border Gradient
desc: Each card computes the pointer angle from its own center and rotates a conic border highlight toward it by the shortest path. Proximity to the center controls highlight intensity.

title: List Reorder Drag
desc: Dragging a row computes a live insertion index from sibling centers. On commit the DOM order changes and every displaced sibling animates from its captured first rectangle to its new position.

title: Zoom UI Inception
desc: Clicking a miniature interface measures its rectangle, expands the outgoing world around that origin, and reconstructs the selected interface as the new full view. A history stack enables reverse navigation.

title: Bento Spotlight
desc: Five procedural bento cells share one cursor-positioned border light, handing the glow across gaps while each miniature graphic responds in its own way.

title: Token Swap Widget
desc: A compact token swap card exchanges stacked amounts and token chips while its conversion rate drifts with a restrained live-market cadence.

title: Drag Collapse Panel
desc: A docked inspector follows its resize edge, turns compression into resistance, and resolves a slow pull or fast flick into a tactile tab.

title: Popover Anchor Morph
desc: One shared popover moves and resizes between three anchors while its caret tracks the trigger and differently sized content crosses over directionally.

title: Table Image Idle
desc: A compact project table carries one persistent living landscape preview between rows, trailing the cursor with subtle velocity and idle motion.

title: Caption Pull Hover
desc: Two independent editorial frames lift their procedural imagery while clipped captions, accent rules, words, and arrows enter and leave in carefully reversed order.

title: Hero Spotlight Reveal
desc: A premium hero assembles through a timed spotlight, masked headline, supporting copy, actions, grain, and rule before settling into a responsive luminous idle.

title: Bayer Dither Field
desc: A true 4×4 Bayer matrix converts a designed grayscale poster into one-bit pixels. The pointer lowers local thresholds in a soft circular field, revealing light without abandoning the ordered pattern.

title: Floyd–Steinberg Resolve
desc: Canonical Floyd–Steinberg diffusion turns a vivid source poster into a one-bit raster. Hover opens a moving window back to the cached RGB source while a lock control resolves the entire frame.

title: Blue-Noise Image Dissolve
desc: A deterministic farthest-point rank mask swaps two complete source images pixel by pixel. Click position leads the transition while spatially separated thresholds avoid the clumps of ordinary random noise.

title: Luminance Halftone Field
desc: A classic 15-degree print screen samples a designed grayscale source into area-correct ink dots. The pointer acts like local pressure, swelling nearby dots while the original luminance structure remains legible.

title: Engraving Line Screen
desc: Parallel engraving ribbons reconstruct a grayscale poster through continuously sampled line weight. Moving across the image rotates and resamples the screen, exposing how angle changes the same tonal source.

title: ASCII Luminance Terminal
desc: A colorful source poster is averaged into fixed cells and rebuilt from a monotonic glyph-density ramp. A cursor lens restores source color independently, while three resolution levels expose the sampling structure.

title: Synthetic ASCII Wave
desc: A camera-like ASCII signal made entirely from three layered sine fields. Pointer velocity injects a decaying spiral disturbance, bending glyph density and color without requesting camera access.

title: ASCII Donut 3D
desc: A classic luminance-shaded torus is rebuilt from 2,160 deterministic samples into a 48 by 24 character z-buffer, with edge-aware accent light and inertial drag rotation.

title: ASCII Fire
desc: A seeded 64 by 28 heat buffer rises through classic three-cell fire propagation, with local cursor wind, four thermal color bands, and a two-second full-fuel surge.

title: ASCII Fluid Stir
desc: A deterministic 48 by 24 density and velocity field uses semi-Lagrangian advection, four-step pressure projection, two living emitters, and a pointer-driven velocity splat.

title: ASCII Portrait Reveal
desc: A deterministic abstract bust is averaged from a 192 by 96 grayscale source into a 48 by 24 glyph field, then develops into sampled tone beneath a squared cursor reveal.

title: ASCII Morph
desc: Two exact 30 by 16 ASCII figures interpolate glyph by glyph through a radial luminance wave with a lavender blank-transition flash.

title: ASCII Type Explode
desc: A native input builds a live 5 by 7 ASCII banner whose deterministic glyph cells fly in, settle, scatter on deletion, and idle-wave by column.

title: Terminal Window
desc: A bounded draggable terminal runs a deterministic command tape with jittered typing, staged output, an ASCII spinner, natural history scrolling, and accessible session tabs.

title: Dot Matrix Shapes
desc: A 56-column LED marquee scrolls hand-built glyphs at a measured speed while its dots morph between four switchable shapes with a column-staggered trough.

title: Halftone Globe Canvas
desc: A deterministic halftone sphere turns through a fixed upper-left light. Stored value-noise continents, cursor-driven axis tilt, backface culling, and a restrained violet terminator make the flat dot field read as a globe.

title: Engraving Lines Warp
desc: Forty-six fine rules bend through a deterministic three-bump relief. A slow periodic noise drift gives the field a currency-engraving breath while the pointer locally doubles and thickens the relief.

title: Pixel Lissajous Lab
desc: A chunky, persistent-canvas Lissajous curve morphs continuously between integer frequency pairs. Six hundred grid-snapped samples leave a restrained phosphor trail while the phase advances forever.

title: RGB Slice Transmission
desc: A cached poster is decomposed into real red, green, and blue channel buffers. Deterministic horizontal bands displace and reconstruct those channels during hover bursts, producing chromatic tears rather than duplicated CSS text.

title: Macroblock Motion Smear
desc: An animated source feeds a persistent frame buffer while deterministic 8px macroblocks are copied from a scratch snapshot along three fading motion trails. The resulting corruption behaves like broken inter-frame prediction.

title: Scanline CRT Receiver
desc: A staged tube-rendering pipeline bends an animated broadcast into two-pixel barrel strips, wraps it through occasional vertical rolls, then applies phosphor scanlines, an RGB shadow mask, roll bloom, and radial vignette.

title: VHS Tracking Deck
desc: Four seeded tracking bands bend two-pixel tape rows through wrapped sine displacement. Disturbed rows receive oppositely shifted red and cyan channel copies plus deterministic head-switching noise.

title: Column Pixel Sort
desc: Every image column owns a stable Rec.709 brightness ordering. Hover bends the row-sampling map toward dark-to-bright vertical streams, while leave reverses to the byte-exact source without cross-fading colors.

title: Reusable Film Grain
desc: A reusable half-resolution canvas overlay generates seeded, bell-shaped monochrome grain at a measured eight frames per second. Intensity, pause, resize, and explicit frame controls stay independent of the artwork beneath it.

title: Threshold Mosaic Switch
desc: Two independently sampled images exchange whole six-pixel tiles through a generated 8×8 Bayer threshold field. Click position leads the ordered front while near-threshold cells briefly contract into a crisp mosaic lattice.

title: Bitmap Type Marquee
desc: A real font phrase is rasterized into an offscreen alpha mask, averaged through four-pixel samples, and rebuilt as five-pixel binary squares. The measured strip then scrolls and wraps without duplicating DOM text.

title: Alternating Field Monitor
desc: Two adjacent-time broadcast buffers are woven one row at a time and swap parity on a measured field cadence. Hover raises restrained field flicker and subpixel line jitter while reduced motion keeps a static interlaced composite.

title: Local Posterize Lens
desc: A measured cursor lens collapses each RGB channel to an exact two- or three-level palette in its core. Full source bytes remain untouched outside, with only a narrow smooth annulus bridging the color-depth boundary.

title: Chromatic Velocity Type
desc: A three-layer display headline tears into cyan and red fringes only when the pointer accelerates. Direction, distance, and a small rotational shear come from measured velocity, then ease back into crisp registration.

title: Soft Focus Switch
desc: A soft-touch switch settles into a recessed cradle and changes a real focus state.

title: Tactile Desk Rocker
desc: A deeply recessed rocker changes the desk light with a convincing two-position tilt.

title: Precision Listening Dial
desc: A weighted satin dial adjusts the listening level through a calibrated arc.

title: Satin Light Fader
desc: A finely brushed vertical fader changes the brightness of the surrounding surface.

title: Weekend Paper Plans
desc: A tactile stack of photographic plans keeps a small checklist on each card.

title: Frosted Coast Pass
desc: A frosted glass pass lifts above a coastal photograph and turns over to reveal the visit details.

title: Dot Matrix Clock
desc: A low-profile charcoal desk clock uses real five-by-seven LED glyphs behind a smoked lens. Discrete physical keys switch the time format and power without altering the proportions of the numerals.

title: Split-Flap Focus Timer
desc: A four-digit mechanical countdown uses separate upper and lower leaves for each flip.

title: Embossed Save Key
desc: A single recessed ceramic key sits in a softly radiused aluminum surround. The cap travels into its socket, then a quiet indicator confirms that the save action has completed.

title: Calibrated Needle Meter
desc: A cream analog meter responds to its calibrated level slider with a damped physical needle.

title: Sculpted Macro Keys
desc: Six sculpted mechanical keycaps control the typography of a live note.

title: Quiet Tape Transport
desc: A molded cassette feeds tape between two real hub assemblies with working transport and position control.

title: Mechanical Counter
desc: Four individually mounted drums roll through clean tabular numerals inside a charcoal counting machine. A large tactile lever advances the sequence; a smaller reset key restores the starting value.

title: Hinged Pocket Lighter
desc: A pocket-sized brushed steel lighter is built around its real hinge: the cap opens, a separate strike wheel ignites the wick, and closing the cap extinguishes it. Its small flame is a restrained translucent volume above a perforated wind guard.

title: Tear-off Note
desc: A useful perforated task card is suspended from a brass clip. Pulling its lower tab separates a naturally irregular paper edge; the saved reminder settles below and the remaining paper retains its own torn silhouette.

title: Sealed Correspondence
desc: A folded cotton-paper envelope closes with a small oxblood wax seal. Pressing the seal breaks it into two natural halves and lifts the flap to reveal a personal note; sealing reverses the complete interaction.

title: Pocket Synthesizer
desc: A compact cream synthesizer has a working two-octave keyboard, four coloured rotary caps and a recessed waveform display. Clicking or using the computer keyboard plays actual notes; filter, tone, decay and volume are independent physical controls.

title: Expanding Activity Capsule
desc: A minimal music activity lives inside a smoothly expanding black capsule at the top of a porcelain phone. Its compact waveform becomes a useful player with transport controls, elapsed time and a seek slider, all within the same surface.

title: Direct-drive Turntable
desc: A compact powder-coated turntable models the platter, concentric record grooves, offset tonearm and cartridge. Starting playback lowers the arm onto the record; cueing lifts it and stops the record, while a physical speed selector changes rotation.

title: Satin Foil Membership
desc: A softly rounded graphite membership card uses an engraved emblem, fine microtexture and a low-opacity foil layer that tracks the light. Pointer tilt and keyboard lighting reveal restrained blue, bronze and sage reflections across a single realistic surface.

title: Mac Minimize / Maximize
desc: A window shrinks into its dock item with scale + translate + fade (macOS "scale effect"), and springs back on click. Computed FLIP-style from real element positions, so it works at any layout.

title: Dock Magnification
desc: Icons swell as the cursor nears, with neighbors partially magnified by a smooth distance falloff — the macOS dock, in ~20 lines.

title: FLIP Card Expand
desc: Click a thumbnail and it grows seamlessly into a detail view using the FLIP technique — layout change first, then an inverted transform plays back. The web version of a shared-element transition.

title: Smooth Accordion
desc: Animating to height:auto — the classic impossible — solved with the grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr trick. No JS measurement, no max-height hacks.

title: Spring Modal
desc: A dialog that enters with scale overshoot (0.9 → 1.02 → 1) and a fading backdrop blur, and exits quickly downward. Snappy in, forgettable out — the correct asymmetry.

title: Inertia Drag Carousel
desc: Grab-and-throw horizontal gallery: pointer drag maps 1:1, release keeps velocity and decays with friction, edges resist with rubber-banding.

title: Directional Hover Fill
desc: A circle expands from the exact point where the cursor entered the button and retreats toward the exit point. Entry/exit-aware fills read as far more "alive" than a flat swap.

title: Page Transition Curtain
desc: Navigation triggers vertical panels that sweep in with a stagger, swap the content while covered, then sweep away. The full-screen wipe between pages on award sites.

title: Infinite Logo Marquee
desc: The pure-CSS infinite logo strip: content duplicated once, animated -50%, edges faded with a mask, paused on hover. Zero JS, perfectly seamless.

title: Inertial Dot Field
desc: A precise dot lattice yields around the pointer with damped spring inertia. Click emits a radial impulse; each dot returns to its original position.

title: Reactive Threads
desc: Thirty-six fine filaments bend as a continuous field around the pointer. A Gaussian falloff keeps the edges quiet while the center feels elastic.

title: Tactile Ballpit
desc: A small pile of dimensional spheres responds to pointer collisions, gravity, and impulse. Pairwise collision resolution separates the bodies, while damping keeps the motion controlled.

title: Ripple Grid
desc: A continuous wire lattice ripples outward from the pointer. Distance-based sine displacement and exponential falloff create the impression of a flexible mesh without WebGL.

title: Magnetic Line Field
desc: A grid of short needles rotates toward a local attractor. Proximity controls line length and contrast, turning a simple angle calculation into a tactile magnetic field.

title: Fading Pixel Trail
desc: A quantized pointer trail leaves crisp square cells that fade at independent rates. Stamps overlap naturally, with no DOM elements created during pointer movement.

title: Elastic Ribbons
desc: Five trailing lines follow a chain of damped positions. Each strand uses a slightly different response, creating a layered ribbon that stretches during quick movements and settles smoothly.

title: Contour Mesh Surface
desc: A sculptural contour surface folds in response to pointer position. This lightweight Canvas 2D study translates the reference’s material movement into fine orange and graphite linework rather than reproducing its shader.

title: Perspective Warp
desc: Nested wire rectangles travel out of a shared vanishing point. Pointer position shifts the perspective, while a brief click impulse changes the speed of the tunnel.

title: Converging Paths
desc: Five independently drawn SVG paths converge into a single signal. A local scroll container maps progress to normalized stroke lengths, keeping the effect usable inside a component preview.

title: Path Follower
desc: A small object follows the exact geometry of an SVG curve. An accessible range input scrubs distance along the path, demonstrating a portable primitive for scroll-driven route and orbit animations.

title: Pointer Mask Reveal
desc: A circular pointer mask reveals a second, contrasting typographic composition. Click expands the aperture; keyboard activation and arrow-key positioning expose the same interaction.

title: Curved Gallery
desc: Seven original line studies travel along a curved carousel. Drag displacement feeds a damped position, release snaps to the nearest artwork, and the gallery wraps infinitely in either direction.

title: Toss & Stack
desc: A three-card stack combines distinct layers, restrained depth, and direct manipulation. Drag beyond a threshold to cycle the front card to the back; smaller gestures spring back into place.

title: Tracing Story
desc: A thin accent beam traces the reading position beside three chapters. A sticky companion panel updates its title and geometric symbol as each chapter becomes active.

title: Elastic Range
