desc: A native accessible range control gains a rubber-band response at its limits. Values remain clamped while excess drag distance stretches the track with square-root resistance, then settles on release.

title: Formatted Metric Counter
desc: A configurable metric with currency, percentage and grouped-number formats. Set a start and target value, then replay a count in either direction.

title: Rolling Account Balance
desc: An account balance whose digits roll independently upward or downward when a payment arrives or money is spent. Currency and decimal punctuation stay still.

title: Focus Countdown Ring
desc: A short focus timer with a readable countdown and circular progress track. Choose a duration, start or pause, and reset without timing drift.

title: Revenue Period Summary
desc: A revenue summary whose total, chart, transaction count and average order animate together when the selected period changes. Inspect chart samples with pointer or keyboard.

title: Dirty Rollin' Slider
desc: A two-tone rolling ball travels through a shallow recessed track. Its coloured face rotates and changes hue as it rolls.

title: DImpled Slider
desc: A wide orange grip with a fine embossed dimple texture slides along a slim light-grey track.

title: Dynamic Slider
desc: A broad white capsule stretches gently under the pointer while its recessed orange mark tracks the value.

title: Square Slider
desc: A chamfered square thumb with a recessed centre glides along a thin straight track.

title: Trackin' Slider
desc: A long pill thumb with five small raised grip lines moves smoothly along a fine volume track.

title: Long Rollin' Slider
desc: A white rolling ball with a single orange locator sits in a softly recessed horizontal channel.

title: Rollin' Dot Slider
desc: An orange spherical thumb moves between six numbered positions inside a shallow channel.

title: Rollin' Stepper
desc: An orange numbered ball rolls between three recessed stops, keeping the selected step in its centre.

title: Standard Volume
desc: A white rotary volume knob inside a broad shallow bezel, with a small orange position marker.

title: Empty Track Volume
desc: A large rotary control with an empty three-quarter track and seven fine calibration ticks.

title: Volume Hidden Track
desc: A compact white rotary knob with a single orange indicator and no visible track.

title: Volume Visible Track
desc: A compact white rotary knob surrounded by a visible three-quarter grey volume track.

title: Rollin' Ball Surprise
desc: A glossy ball sits in a rounded square recess. A small orange dot rolls to the top and becomes two tiny eyes when pressed.

title: Rollin' Search
desc: A small orange search orb rolls to the right as a pale search field expands from it. Type a query and press Enter; Escape folds it away.

title: Ball Pop
desc: A white confirmation ball springs out of a shallow circular recess, showing a small orange checkmark. Press again to return it to the recess.

title: DRAMS · OP1
desc: A compact seven-key tactile cluster with three tonal selectors and four playable notes. The native version includes keyboard performance and gesture-gated audio.

title: DRAMS · R2D2
desc: A softly lit spherical droid control with segmented radial panels, a rotating shell and inertial drag.

title: DRAMS · Digital Clock Radio
desc: A small satin clock radio with working analog hands, station presets and a physical power control.

title: DRAMS · Braun Electric Shaver
desc: A native foil-shaver material study with a working power state, fine cutter detail and restrained moving-hair feedback.

title: DRAMS · Rotary Radio
desc: A fan-scale radio with a recessed slotted speaker, rotating tuning dial and physical top power switch.

title: DRAMS · Digital Rotary Radio
desc: A tall perforated radio with a stepped encoder, station selection, a physical power key and a small built-in clock.

title: Dark Volume
desc: A native, accessible recreation of DRAMS 008, Dark Volume, with its original physical composition and direct manipulation.

title: 3-Way Knob
desc: A native, accessible recreation of DRAMS 011, 3-Way Knob, with its original physical composition and direct manipulation.

title: Round Knob Slider
desc: A native, accessible recreation of DRAMS 013, Round Knob Slider, with its original physical composition and direct manipulation.

title: Joypad Controller
desc: A native, accessible recreation of DRAMS 015, Joypad Controller, with its original physical composition and direct manipulation.

title: Plus Minus Knob
desc: A native, accessible recreation of DRAMS 016, Plus Minus Knob, with its original physical composition and direct manipulation.

title: Round On/Off Knob
desc: A native, accessible recreation of DRAMS 017, Round On/Off Knob, with its original physical composition and direct manipulation.

title: Line Volume
desc: A native, accessible recreation of DRAMS 019, Line Volume, with its original physical composition and direct manipulation.

title: Fingerin' Volume
desc: A native, accessible recreation of DRAMS 025, Fingerin' Volume, with its original physical composition and direct manipulation.

title: Hollin' Volume
desc: A native, accessible recreation of DRAMS 032, Hollin' Volume, with its original physical composition and direct manipulation.

title: Crankin' Ball
desc: A native, accessible recreation of DRAMS 038, Crankin' Ball, with its original physical composition and direct manipulation.

title: Pendulum
desc: A native, accessible recreation of DRAMS 046, Pendulum, with its original physical composition and direct manipulation.

title: Bouncin' Ball
desc: A native, accessible recreation of DRAMS 047, Bouncin' Ball, with its original physical composition and direct manipulation.

title: I/O Switch
desc: A 79×40 I/O toggle with a 34px raised pale cap, recessed grey rail and exposed I/O marks

title: Pushin' Click Button
desc: A 108px circular push key has a satin concave pale face, dark layered base, separate 12px LED and momentary vertical press travel

title: Concaved Switch
desc: A 108px orange concave rocker with grey rim and separate LED; the cavity shading and curved inner face reverse when engaged

title: 3-Way Switch
desc: A 148px recessed trough, three top markers and a 28×49 raised pinch handle

title: LED Switch
desc: A recessed 79×40 toggle between hollow and filled circular indicators, with a soft raised pale cap and contact shadow

title: Square Switch
desc: A squared 106×40 rail and 40px sliding key with nine tactile dimples

title: Coloured Switch
desc: A permanently orange circular cap crosses a recessed grey/orange track with a directional soft shadow

title: Pinchin' Track Switch
desc: A 76px twin-dimple pinch key moves along a thin exposed 139px horizontal track with a separate endpoint LED

title: Long Pinchin' Switch
desc: A long 198×48 rail with a 132px twin-dimple paddle; the orange dot transfers between the paddle ends as it slides

title: Pinchin' Switch
desc: A compact 129px capsule and 78px double-dimple key leave a round indicator at the free end

title: Pushin' 5'ers
desc: Five adjacent 38px keys share a rounded base

title: Triple Light Switch
desc: Three independent tall rockers share a 196×144 wall plate

title: Fidget Poppin'
desc: Six independent 44px domes in a 212×144 fidget pad

title: Triple Push Buttons
desc: Three separated 40px push buttons use orange, pale alloy and graphite materials, independent top LEDs, dark sidewalls and momentary press travel

title: Rollin' Dot Switch
desc: A shaded 54px sphere rolls over a 98px capsule

title: Standard Switch
desc: A minimal 79×40 standard switch has a flat pale rail and a raised 34px white cap; orange appears behind the right-hand active cap

title: Rollin' Switch
desc: A 42px rolling sphere sits inside an 86px recessed trough with a pale double rim

title: Triple Switch
desc: Three independent vertical pinch switches: a 40×68 double-dimple grip on each thin 120px track, spaced 48px apart

title: Slurp Switch
desc: A spare 79px spring toggle paired with one detached 12px LED
